name: How do restoration companies handle water-damaged restaurant equipment and inventory?

mainEntity.name: How do restoration companies handle water-damaged restaurant equipment and inventory?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional restoration companies prioritize the assessment and mitigation of damage to restaurant equipment and inventory. They will carefully move salvageable items to a dry, secure location. Specialized drying techniques are used for inventory like packaged foods or non-perishable goods that can be saved. Equipment is assessed for electrical safety and damage; some items can be restored, while others may need replacement. Detailed inventory lists are created for insurance claims.
acceptedAnswer.description: They assess, move salvageable items, use specialized drying for inventory, and evaluate equipment for restoration or replacement.
